interpretation: Post-review supplemental comparisons on previously used task seeds; not new independent confirmatory evidence. The standardized d=1000 control was already observed in the submission review and is reused unchanged.

standardized_generic_dct_maximin.coordinate: Exactly the source atlas 18 cosine and diagonal-square coordinates; K=8, kappa=0.25, shared library nodes.
standardized_generic_dct_maximin.standardization: Subtract each library-column mean and divide by its population standard deviation; replace scales <=1e-10 by 1, exactly as the existing source atlas.
standardized_generic_dct_maximin.first_center: Minimum mean Euclidean distance to the standardized finite library; stable library index tie break.
standardized_generic_dct_maximin.remaining_centers: Existing deterministic Gonzalez farthest-first until ten distinct profiles.

source_greedy_portfolio.description: A simple source-greedy portfolio control adapted to this ordered-policy, chance-constrained archive; not a reproduction of Auto-sklearn 2.0.
source_greedy_portfolio.archive: The same two source tasks, 64 profiles and three paired simulator replications as source_atlas; 384 source calls, source task and sample seeds unchanged.
source_greedy_portfolio.profile_order: Lexicographically sorted common profile IDs, as in source_atlas.
source_greedy_portfolio.safety_statistic: Mean source constraint samples + NormalQuantile(1-alpha) * sqrt(max(unbiased sample variance,1e-6)) - tau; exactly source_atlas.
source_greedy_portfolio.ranks: Average-tie percentile ranks in [0,1], separately within each source task, using existing percentile_ranks.
source_greedy_portfolio.greedy_rule: At each step select the unselected profile j minimizing mean_t min_{k in selected union {j}} s[t,k]. Start with the empty set; first step minimizes mean_t s[t,j].
source_greedy_portfolio.tie_break: First lower overall mean_t s[t,j], then stable profile index. Continue to exactly ten profiles, including after the archive objective stops improving.

analysis.endpoint: Independently certified deployment whose post-run audit is truly feasible; also report initial feasible coverage, false certificates, penalized loss and all-in calls.
analysis.pairing: Exact regime, dimension, target_seed and design_seed; no pairing inferred from a filename substring.
analysis.uncertainty: For each dimension, 10000 paired bootstrap replicates resample 20 tasks separately within each of the fixed eight regimes; report percentile 95% intervals. Per-regime intervals resample its 20 paired tasks. The three resolutions are never treated as 480 independent tasks.
analysis.cost: Source calls divided by M plus observed target search and verification calls; report total calls and calls per true safe certificate at M=1,20,100, and the amortization crossing.
analysis.raw_reference_validation: Check compact original summaries against local source/legacy scalar rows before combining them.
analysis.output: Compact scalar rows and selected profile IDs; no full policy vectors or checkpoints.

frozen_materials: Do not change the existing core, runner, historical protocols or historical results.
